note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user account controls (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Pinnable section headers -- renders: 'Contents' or 'Appearance' label and unpin button
Page title bar -- renders: 'Talk' namespace label, 'Web accessibility' page title, language selector, 'Add section' button
Page view tabs and tools -- renders: 'Read', 'Edit', 'View history', 'Tools'
Appearance settings panel -- renders: 'Appearance', 'Text', 'Width', 'Theme', and fixed option labels (Small/Medium/Large, Standard/Wider, System/Day/Night)
Page subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Site footer -- renders: copyright notices, license links, and fixed navigation links (Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact Wikipedia, etc.)
